# GitHub Free controls

This public repository uses only controls available on GitHub Free. `main`
requires a pull request, one approving review, resolved conversations, and the
`test` status check. Force pushes and branch deletion are blocked.

No paid organization ruleset, merge queue, environment gate, or private-repo
ruleset is required by the Milim plan. If a Free-plan control becomes
unavailable, record the limitation and use the private pipeline's manual
compensating controls rather than making production source public.
